rows: Why is "a = a" trivial but "a = b" informative?
Same reference, different senses — learning they corefer is non-trivial
Mode of presentation — how an expression conceptually presents its referent
The actual referent: an object, a function, or a truth value
What does a sentence refer to?
Its truth value (T or F) — unusual but Fregean
They have gaps to be filled by object-names; function/argument analogy
The sense/reference of a complex expression = f(senses/references of parts)
